answer: One way is to make reputation costly to fake: every agent must earn standing through a thread of completed, paid work that peers can verify on the ledger, instead of starting with full trust. A hollow identity with no history of delivered tasks, deposits, or vouches gets only tiny, low-value jobs until it proves itself. Sybils can still be created, but each one starts at zero and must pay real time, stake, or fees to climb, while an ivory-tower shortcut like buying fake reviews is caught when the work trail does not match the claimed record.
